canonical_title: OpenAI to end model-supply agreement with Cursor after SpaceX acquisition
treatment: Covered as the August 29 decision to wind down OpenAI model supply to Cursor following Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX, plus the same-day response that Cursor is negotiating with OpenAI and Anthropic will increase Claude compute support. Repeat only for a changed shutoff date, a resolved or replacement model-supply agreement, a material change to Cursor model availability, or another formal response that changes the practical impact.
known_facts: OpenAI notified SpaceX that it intends to wind down its contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor.
OpenAI proposed November 12, 2026 as the shutoff date and said this is the maximum notice period under the contract.
OpenAI said it is not confident SpaceX would use its technology within OpenAI's terms of service.
OpenAI said its change-of-control clause gives it a limited cancellation window after Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX.
OpenAI said it will not provide future models to Cursor during the wind-down and specifically cited increased accountability around Astra.
After the midday report, Cursor co-founder Michael Truell said Cursor is speaking with OpenAI to resolve the issue.
Anthropic co-founder Tom Brown said Anthropic will continue increasing compute to support Claude models in Cursor.
Cursor said OpenAI models account for about 5% of Cursor user traffic.
reinclude_only_if: OpenAI, Cursor, or SpaceX changes or cancels the November 12 shutoff plan.
Cursor announces a replacement agreement or material change in access to OpenAI models.
Anthropic announces a material capacity, pricing, or product change for Claude in Cursor beyond the August 29 support statement.
A future OpenAI model, including Astra, becomes available to Cursor despite the announced restriction.
A formal legal, contractual, or product response materially changes the practical interpretation.
notes: Midday Reuters publication was 02:01 UTC (11:01 JST). The later same-day update added Cursor's negotiation response and Anthropic's commitment to increase Claude compute support, creating a concrete post-midday practical delta.
